notes: No existing file was modified; all six files are new.

examples/zedboard_blinky.sv does not exist on the fm/zedboard-merge base; local style was taken from examples/blinky.sv and from origin/fm/zedboard-blinky:examples/zedboard_blinky.sv (read-only reference, not modified).

OLED fixed per origin/fm/zedboard-rung5-review:docs/zedboard/rung5-review.md: part-select of function call replaced by an intermediate logic [15:0] entry signal; D/C low for all 25 init bytes and high only for the 512 display bytes, ROM is_data flag removed; SDIN now changes on the SCLK falling edge, SCLK rises half a period later; VDD and VBAT drive inverted to active low.

OLED power order fixed to the SSD1306 datasheet order: VDD on, RES low then high, VBAT on, wait 100 ms before the first init byte (0xAF display on is last in the init list). VDD/VBAT active-low polarity confirmed from Digilent DSDB Reference Manual Table 11 (same UG-2832HSWEG04 display): VBAT# and VDD# power enables are active low; corroborated by the Digilent Orbit BoosterPack manual (pins driven low to turn on) and the TU Darmstadt oled_ctrl.v ZedBoard controller (pins high at reset, low to power on). ZedBoard schematic Rev C.1 sheet 6 shows the DISP1 connector with VBAT pin 5 and VDD pin 7 on nets NLOLED0VBAT/NLOLED0VDD.
VGA outputs vga_r/g/b/hs/vs are now registered together (one clock later, staying aligned) to avoid combinational glitches, per the review note.

OLED testbench examples/zedboard_oled_tb.sv written: SSD1306 SPI model samples SDIN on SCLK rising, checks D/C per byte, the 25 init bytes, the 512 data bytes, the power order, the 100 ms VBAT wait, and 100 ns SDIN setup. Not run here: no simulator installed on this box. Run on the Mac.
Testbenches for Pmod and VGA and zedbit bitstreams are the remaining follow-ups: run zedbit with --ignore-timing when no other cargo build is running.

oled_ssd1306_spi.description: Bit-banged SPI (500 kHz, mode 0, MSB first) SSD1306 driver: VDD on (active low), 1 ms wait, RES low then high, VBAT on (active low), 100 ms wait, 25-command init list with D/C low for every init byte, then 512-byte display RAM fill with alternating 0xAA/0x55 stripes and D/C high; SDIN changes on the SCLK falling edge so each bit has a full half period of setup; led lights on done.
oled_ssd1306_spi.testbench_result: written, not run, no simulator installed

pmod_loopback.description: Drives test patterns out of Pmod JA, samples Pmod JB after a 1 ms settle, compares. Requires eight jumper wires JA to JB pin for pin. Patterns: walking 1 (x2), walking 0 (x2), 0x55, 0xAA, incrementing counter. led[0] pass so far, led[1] error latched, led[7:2] mismatch count.

vga_640x480.description: 640x480 at 60 Hz from 100 MHz GCLK with divide-by-4 pixel clock enable (25 MHz). H total 800 (640+16+96+48), V total 525 (480+10+2+33), sync active low. Eight vertical color bars plus white border frame; led toggles once per frame. vga_r/g/b/hs/vs are registered together, one clock later, staying aligned.
